name: 32258 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32258 (Jacksonville) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32258 (Jacksonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32258 (Jacksonville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
